name: Play or explain specific board and card games
description: Users asked the AI to play a variety of distinct board, card, word, trivia, and logic games, or to explain the rules and strategies for them. The requests included interactive turn-based games like Tic-Tac-Toe and Connect Four, as well as requests for specific moves, move lists, or rule clarifications for chess and poker.
